node_8.description: This is Tamara Taylor's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00 am, wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00 am, eat breakfast and review school notes from 7:30 am to 8:00 am, attend high school classes from 8:30 am to 3:00 pm, have lunch at school at 12:00 pm, practice music theory exercises from 3:30 pm to 4:30 pm, ask Eddy Lin for help with music theory from 4:45 pm to 5:30 pm, eat dinner at 6:00 pm, listen to classical music and relax from 6:30 pm to 7:30 pm, complete homework from 8:00 pm to 10:00 pm, wind down and prepare for bed from 11:00 pm to 12:00 am, go to bed at 12:00 am.
